# FluxWall

> FluxWall is a live wallpaper app for Android. Explore beautiful moving worlds, personalize your style, and make your screen yours.

## Canonical website

- Website: https://fluxwall.abhishekbansal.dev/
- Android app: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.rrapps.infinitetunnel
- Public source repository: https://github.com/abhishekBansal/fluxwall

## What FluxWall is

FluxWall is a live wallpaper app for Android. Users can explore a curated collection of moving worlds, preview them, and personalize settings such as color, speed, glow, density, and flow. The Android app is available on Google Play.

FluxWall is designed for Android devices that support live wallpapers. It does not require an account, and the app contains no ads or tracking.

## Featured worlds

The public website showcases five curated experiences:

- Infinite Tunnel: a fast-moving tunnel journey with luminous rings.
- Magic Fluids: rich, colorful motion with flowing color.
- Aurora Field: soft northern lights over a dark sky.
- Synthwave Sun: a bright retro sunset with a neon horizon.
- Galaxy: deep space with slow-moving stars.

## How it works

FluxWall creates the movement on your phone, so scenes can feel different every time you look at them. The public website includes a preview of the featured experiences.

## Frequently asked questions

### Is FluxWall a video wallpaper?

No. FluxWall creates a moving scene on your phone. It is not a fixed video loop.

### What can users customize?

Each world can include its own controls. Available settings may include color palettes, speed, glow, density, flow mode, and related visual options.

### Does FluxWall need an account?

No. FluxWall does not require an account. Favorites and presets are stored locally on the device according to the app's user settings.

### Does FluxWall contain ads?

No ads, no account, and no tracking inside the app.

### Where can FluxWall be downloaded?

FluxWall is available on Google Play at:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.rrapps.infinitetunnel
